subject: design/feature-neutral-plan
statement: Name a plan by its Feature or Intake header, require a lock Basis for draft-born feature plans, and omit feature-only fields from non-feature plan handoffs.
intent: Let feature and non-feature work share the same plan fold and tracker projection while preserving existing feature plan bytes.
rationale: The parser keeps the closed header grammar, the model derives task and epic identities from the naming row, and the fold checks coverage only for a governing PRD. Task bodies, spec carriers, projection reports, and the viewer omit absent feature fields. Existing document-pipeline faces verify byte for byte.
fit_criterion: A draft-born header parses with a lock Basis, an intake fixture folds and projects in both legacy and native dialects without feature-only fields, and the existing feature-draft plan verifies against its committed face.
